paraphrase: When Nāropa manifested the maṇḍala of Hevajra, Marpa prostrated to the deity rather than to his guru; Nāropa said that without the guru even the name of buddha would not be heard, and foretold that Marpa's family line would scatter while his Dharma lineage would continue.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally.

paraphrase: Marpa gathered gold and travelled to India three times (by the usual account), receiving the tantras, the six dharmas and Mahāmudrā from Nāropa, Maitrīpa and other masters.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally.
